disp.start.marina: [bored] Morning, crew! [sarcastic] Lovely view of the bridge from the Palace. Keep those robotaxis rolling!
disp.start.lombard: [smug] Crookedest street in the world, steepest shift of the day. [mischievously] Up to Coit Tower and back!
disp.start.ferry: [sighs] Lunch rush downtown! [sarcastic] From the Pyramid to the Ferry Building, everybody's on the move.
disp.start.ladies: [sarcastic] Golden hour on Alamo Square! Everybody's taking pictures of the Painted Ladies. [whiny] Go, go, go!
disp.start.beach: [mischievously] Karl's rolling in over Ocean Beach. [bored] Windmills to Sutro Baths, keep those cars running!
disp.call.dirty: [snickers] One of ours took a mud bath. [bossy] Grab the sponge!
disp.call.charge: [sarcastic] Battery's running on two percent. [impatient] Plug it in!
disp.call.cone: [smug] Somebody boxed a car in with cones. [bored] Clear the road!
disp.call.birds: [snickers] Pigeons on the lidar! [sarcastic] They think it's a heated seat!
disp.call.reboot: [sighs] One of ours is having a moment. [sarcastic] Turn it off and on again!
disp.call.vacuum: [disgusted] Popcorn all over the back seat! [mocking] Was somebody watching a movie?
disp.call.doors: [whiny] Riders left the doors open. [bossy] Go bump them shut!
disp.perfect.2: [sarcastic] Textbook! [mocking] I'm writing that one down!
disp.perfect.3: [surprised] So fast! [teasing] Are you secretly a robot too?
disp.combo.1: [sarcastic] That's a streak! The whole fleet's honking for you!
disp.combo.2: [snickers] On a roll! [teasing] Don't get a big head!
disp.miss.1: [snickers] Aw, that rider walked. [sarcastic] It happens!
disp.miss.2: [mocking] Oops, we lost that one. [bored] The next one's yours!
disp.miss.3: [sighs] One got away. [sarcastic] Shake it off!
disp.hurry: [whiny] Twenty seconds left! [impatient] Just a few more, you've got this!
disp.result.good: [grudgingly] Great shift! [sarcastic] The riders are sending you heart emojis.
disp.result.ok: [sarcastic] Not bad at all! [smug] The next shift's gonna be even better.
disp.final.platinum: [surprised] Platinum! Best pit crew in the whole city! [smug] I'm telling everyone!
disp.final.gold: [grudgingly] Gold! [sarcastic] The fleet's never been this shiny!
disp.final.silver: [sarcastic] Silver! A really solid day. [mocking] I'm proud of you!
disp.final.bronze: [bored] Bronze! You kept the city moving. [sarcastic] That counts!
disp.final.none: [snickers] Rough day, huh? Grab a coffee. [sarcastic] We'll get them next time!
rider.dirty.1: [shocked] Is that a seagull's doing? On my window? [indignant] I'm on vacation!
rider.dirty.2: [frustrated] I can't see the Bay Bridge! [whining] I came all the way from Ohio!
rider.dirty.3: [dramatically] I cannot take a selfie in a muddy car. [sighs] I just can't.
rider.charge.1: [elderly voice] [sweetly] It says two percent, dear. [curious] Is that bad?
rider.charge.2: [stressed] We stopped? [panicked] I have a standup in four minutes!
rider.cone.1: [amazed] Cones! All the way around us! [dreamily] Is this an art piece?
rider.cone.2: [deadpan] Coned in. Again. [sighs] Classic San Francisco.
rider.birds.1: [delighted] The pigeons won't let us leave! [curious] Do I tip them?
rider.birds.2: [deadpan] There's a gull staring at me through the roof. He wants my fries.
rider.reboot.1: [elderly voice] The car says it can't see. [chuckles] Honestly? Me neither!
rider.reboot.2: [impatient] Hello? Car? Are you okay in there? [exasperated] Blink twice!
rider.vacuum.1: [elderly voice] [curious] Whose sock is this? [confused] Why is it warm?
rider.vacuum.2: [disgusted] I am not sitting in that popcorn. [dramatically] I'm wearing linen!
rider.doors.1: [nervous laugh] Oops! Did I leave the door open? [embarrassed] All of them?
rider.doors.2: [sheepishly] Sorry! My hands were full of burritos!
